tool.title: enable (rappture2web)
tool.about:
Examples of Rappture <enable> attributes.
The <enable> attribute can be used to selectively enable/disable one object based on the value of others.

about.label: Model
about.description: Select the simulation model to use.

about.label: Drift-Diffusion
about.description: Classical drift-diffusion transport model

about.label: Boltzmann Transport Equation
about.description: Semi-classical Boltzmann transport equation model

about.label: Quantum Mechanical NEGF
about.description: Quantum mechanical non-equilibrium Green's function model

about.label: Recombination Model
about.description: Enable or disable the carrier recombination model.

about.label: Minority Carrier Lifetime for electrons
about.description: Minority carrier lifetime for electrons used in the recombination model.

about.label: Minority Carrier Lifetime for holes
about.description: Minority carrier lifetime for holes used in the recombination model.

about.label: Temperature
about.description: Lattice temperature for the BTE simulation.

about.label: Secret input number
about.description: A hidden integer input used for internal purposes.

about.label: Tight-binding Energy
about.description: Energy parameter for the tight-binding Hamiltonian in the NEGF model.

about.label: High-energy lifetime
about.description: Lifetime for high-energy carriers above the tight-binding energy threshold.

about.label: Selected settings
about.description: Log summary of the enabled inputs and selected model.
